summary.text: Jacklyn Rusnock is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 126 who has served since December 1, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She worked as a teacher and educator before entering the legislature.

paragraphs.text: Jacklyn Rusnock earned a high school diploma from Muhlenberg High School in 1989 and a bachelor's degree in dental hygiene from West Virginia University in 1993.
Her career experience includes working as a teacher and educator.
Rusnock assumed office on December 1, 2024, succeeding Mark Rozzi.
She won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary over Joshua Caltagirone, 85.2% to 14.7%, and faces Republican Miguel Vasquez in the general election.
